title: StreetNets: Democratizing Topological Analysis of Urban Street Networks
description: StreetNets is a no-code dashboard built with Streamlit and OSMnx for retrieving, visualizing, analyzing, and exporting street networks from OpenStreetMap. It computes topological metrics, a functional road hierarchy (Highways, Arterial, Local), centrality, orientation, disruption and robustness analyses, and compares networks against a database of 18 pre-analyzed cities.
